title: Ext of finite modules over a Noetherian ring is finite
statement: If $A$ is a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $M,N$ are finite $A$-modules [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], then for every integer $q \ge 0$ the Ext group $\operatorname{Ext}^q_A(M,N)$ [def-pc-ext], computed in the abelian category of $A$-modules, is a finite $A$-module.
